description: Every legacy .html URL on taxiverz.com and its single-hop 301 target on the new site. Generated in Phase 0 from the real files (repo == live file set, 156 pages).

rules.matching: Case-insensitive; match both raw and %20-encoded forms; also match without the leading slash variants the server may log. The live Apache server is case-sensitive today (e.g. /Gypsy.html is 200, /gypsy.html is 404).
rules.redirect: 301, single hop. At build time each legacy URL points at `target` if that page is published, otherwise at `fallback`, otherwise '/'. Phase 7 asserts the effective destination returns 200.
rules.confidence: high = target is certain; medium = sensible default, owner may change the slug; needs-owner = depends on an OWNER_TODO answer.
rules.linkedFrom: anchor = linked with a crawlable <a href>; js-only = reachable only via onclick/JS or non-anchor markup; orphan = referenced by no other page.
rules.longDistance: Routes whose one-way distance exceeds 600 km stay draft until the owner confirms them (REBUILD_PLAN §5); their legacy URLs use the fallback meanwhile.
rules.launch: At launch no legacy URL may land on '/' except index.html, index-backup.html and popular-routes-section.html (Google treats mass redirects to the home page as soft 404s). Checked by `npm run redirects:check -- --launch` (REBUILD_PLAN Phase 7).
